label: Illustrative AI output
callWith: The member, on the number from the ED face sheet

transcript.speaker: Care manager
transcript.text: Hi, is this Jaylen? This is T. Nguyen, a care manager with Scioto Community Health. The ED at Mercy gave us this number. Is now OK?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: Yeah. Who told you? I've got a few minutes left on this phone.

transcript.speaker: Care manager
transcript.text: The ED's case manager called us. Before we go further, your release for the treatment program has expired. Would you be willing to renew it?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: Yeah, I guess. If it gets me back on subs.

transcript.speaker: Care manager
transcript.text: Are you on anything right now?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: No. Nothing since jail. They gave me a few days when I got out and that was it. I stopped the lithium months ago.

transcript.speaker: Care manager
transcript.text: Have you used since the overdose?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: Not really. I don't want to talk about that.

transcript.speaker: Care manager
transcript.text: That's OK. Any thoughts of hurting yourself today?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: My friend's place on Livingston. Minutes run out around the middle of the month, so after that you can't reach me.

transcript.speaker: Care manager
transcript.text: Anything coming up I should know about?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: Court on the 18th, and no way to get there. And the stitches come out on the 12th at Mercy.
